old_findings.note: onSwap still aborted at the same point (only trailing blank lines changed)
onRegister now reads bool _param7 (calldata word 7, enableDonation); parameters are numbered by calldata word throughout
getPoolConfig/totalSupply calls decoded (raw args 4 -> 0), permit's ecrecover shows its arguments, raw returns 7 -> 1; the recovered address is still read from mem[mem[64] + 12 len 20]
immutables still 0; functions using the weights now end in an unconditional Panic(50)

regressions.source: abi.decode of Vault return data (PoolConfig, token arrays)
regressions.issue: Exact free-pointer values are printed in full at every use, so the return-data checks carry sums of up to ten terms: lines over 200 chars 7 -> 62, over 300 chars 2 -> 14, lines with 4+ ceil32 terms 0 -> 58.
regressions.rule: Bind a compound free-pointer value to a temporary at its read (p = mem[64]) and print addresses as p + k.

improvements: P6 fixed. Parameters numbered by calldata word (onRegister _param7, hooks _param5/_param6/_param8). getPoolConfig and totalSupply decoded; permit's ecrecover shows its digest and v, r, s. Returns decoded as Array(...) or tuples (raw returns 7 -> 1, 2 copy loops each gone). getWeightedPoolImmutableData and getCowPoolImmutableData end at the always-failing weight lookup (immutables 0) with the dead rest dropped (230 -> 84 lines); getMinTokenBalances drops 6 bounds checks dominated by 'if _2 > k'.
notes: Diff 1818 lines, reviewed function by function (18 changed). The validation requires of getPoolConfig's struct are all still present (with longer addresses). Dead-line removals checked against the source: _getNormalizedWeights indexes [0] of a new uint256[](_totalTokens) with _totalTokens = 0, so it always reverts with Panic(50).
summary: No semantic regression; free-pointer values printed in full lengthen the decoding checks (lines over 300 chars 2 -> 14). Improved: parameter numbering fixed, Vault calls and returns decoded, dead code after the always-failing weight lookup dropped.
